notes.title: Patch Notes: Merry Christmas Edition! 🐉✨
notes.notes:
Hey adventurers, first of all:

Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays to you all!

I have taken some extra time before the next content update and the upcoming roadmap (more on that soon) to squash some more bugs, and rework some of the systems that were causing frustrating experiences.

It's important to get the critical issues out of the way before the new spells, enemies, and characters are added to the game. Exciting stuff is coming!


🎄⚔️ Black Dragon Mage Xmas Bugfix Update ⚔️🎄

Version Highlights:

 Completely replaced input system to resolve gamepad-related freezes or scenarios where the controller stopped responding.
 Reworked boss AI for more reliable and fair boss fights.
 Reworked upgrade picker algorithm so you get more relevant and fun options. Reduced some of the upgrade restrictions so you see more upgrades regardless of choices.
 Adjusted XP gain curve for faster level-ups, so you can build a more powerful mage during your run.
 Brought back some later stage mob enemies with bigger XP gem loot, so it doesn't get too easy with the new changes.
 Made various upgrades more powerful and less punishing.

  
[hr][/hr]


🛠️ Improvements 🛠️

 Greater upgrade variety and more relevance through algorithm adjustments. You'll see a bigger variety of upgrades now, with a better synergy fit. Additionally, speedups to parts of the Level-Up-Curve for better pacing.
 Adjusted boss encounters to match more powerful player builds.
 Luminor, the Pyramid Boss, replaced his rotating attack with a more dodgeable, less frustrating alternative.
 Reaper now has two difficult stages (one per encounter), announces attacks visually and has a death roar. His charges are more predictable. If you previously had a hard time with him, give him another try - he should give you a little more breathing room and won't torment you quite as much, at least on the early encounter.


🐛 Bug Fixes 🐛

 Fixed Tharnok zoning out mid-battle. He's dreamy but focused now!
 Player pickup range upgrades increased in effect.
 Fixed issues with getting stuck after the credits.
 Smoothed out pause menu state management (no more lingering menus!).


🧙‍♂️ Player Quality of Life 🧙‍♂️

 Autofire now displays its target location and your mouse cursor when you switch it on, while playing with mouse input. Bonus tip: Hold down the fire button to override the target temporarily (gamepad users can just use their right stick) while auto-aiming.
 Improved quest board - completed quests are now clearly ticked off. A more automated reward flow, based on player feedback, is coming in the future.


✨ Magic and Visual Tweaks ✨

 Shield of Frost now adjusts its collision layer dynamically, allowing you to escape mosh pits even with the shield on.
 Prismatic Staff visuals adjusted for more clarity and resolved some visual glitches.
 Boss area attacks now have visual accents to draw more attention.


📜 Gameplay Adjustments 📜

 Gem Attraction Scroll drop rate increased and now attracts gems more reliably.
 Improved spawning balance across multiple levels.


🎮 Controls and Menus 🎮

 Improved menu navigation for smoother browsing.
 Fixed cursor visibility logic—no more weird flickering!
 Controller type detection restored for proper glyph mapping.


🎶 Audio Updates 🎶

 Boss music now streams to avoid annoying hiccup when the boss spawns in.


💡 Miscellaneous 💡

 Experience bar updates immediately during level-ups or gem attract scroll pickups.
 Smoothed out transitions when exiting the Hall of Relics.
 Debug tools sped up for faster playtesting (devs are happy!).


🎁 Thanks for playing, Mages! May your magic burn bright, your dragons soar high, and your holidays be magical! 🐉✨ ~ datablob, solo dev of Black Dragon Mage

[hr][/hr]

 A short holiday break for datablob
 Initial Roadmap
 Content Update

notes.title: 🧙‍♂️ Early Access - Patch 3
notes.notes:
Fellow Adventurers,  

Another update has landed, focused on squashing bugs. Here’s what’s new:  

🔧 Tweaks and Adjustments  

 Improved environment culling interval to take into account your performance, resulting in less environment pop-in.
 Improved cleanup routines when exiting the main game loop.  


✨ Improvements  
  
 Enhanced Steam Overlay UI support—now the game pauses properly when the overlay is invoked.  This was critical for Steam Deck certification! Black Dragon Mage is now Steam Deck Verified. 
 Addressed player movement issues when framerate was low or artificially limited. Now you can use the Steam Deck frame limiter (or other frame limiters on e.g. laptops, when trying to save on battery) without additional slowdowns.


🐞 Bug Fixes  

 Area text now hides faster during menu interactions and other transitions, as well as showing more reliably upon map enter.   
 Resolved a bug causing the autofire button prompt to appear offset and overlapping with text, particularly in the Spanish version.
 Improved how sounds are cleared when exiting maps or shops, ensuring smoother transitions across various exit paths.
 Solved an issue where dashing wasn’t available after entering the shop post-match.
 Fixed redundant data migration processes that could result in shop currency loss upon first migration.
 Resolved a bug with shop menu pausing inconsistently.  
 Fixed looping sound issue after dying to bosses and exit sequences.  


Thanks for your support and feedback—it’s invaluable in Early Access!
I’m continuing to work on making the game bigger, better and smoother. 🛠️

What's next:
Content update, including more spell power and further improvements, is on the horizon for next week's patch. Until then, happy adventuring! 🐉✨

notes.title: 🧙‍♂️ Early Access - Patch 2
notes.notes:
Fellow Adventurers,  

Thank you for sticking with me and sharing your feedback, bug reports, and even your frustrations. I hear you, and I’ve been working to make your experience smoother and more rewarding. Here’s what’s new in this update:  

💰 Loot and Spell Improvements  
  
 Reapers now drop better loot, making them even more worth the fight!  
 Added new stat upgrades for the Pentagram spell. More serious upgrades for the spells coming soon.
  

🎮 Controller Updates and Fixes  
  
 Fully reworked the UI system for much more reliable controller gameplay.  
  - Big thanks to vashTstampede for the log files
 Improved controller UI detection:
  - You can now leave a controller plugged in while playing with keyboard and mouse. This one’s for you, Moczan!  
 Secondary mappings have been added to the controls list in the pause menu for easier reference.  
 More accurate controller detection overall for a smoother experience.  
  

🛠️ Bug Fixes and Adjustments  
  
 Fixed a bug where you could dash and shop at the same time (thanks cnote291 for pointing this out!).  
 Potion counter achievements are now tracked correctly—no more missed milestones!  
 Interact in the Hall of Relics has been remapped to E on the keyboard for consistency.  
 Adjusted the perk upgrade selection algorithm for better variety and balance.  
  

Thanks again for your patience while I work to make the game even better. I couldn’t do it without your help, and I really appreciate all the support you’ve shown—even when things haven’t been perfect right out of the gate. I'm committed to making Black Dragon Mage a great game during and after Early Access!  

More updates are in the works, and I’m excited to share them with you soon! Until then, happy adventuring. 🐉✨

notes.title: 🧙‍♂️ Early Access - Patch 1 is out!
notes.notes:
Fellow Adventurers, thank you for your letters filled with feedback, praise, and concerns.  
I've read every single one of them! 📜  

This first Early Access patch brings a collection of fixes and tweaks to make your next dragon ride even smoother.  

✨ Improvements Based on Player Feedback  
  
 Base walk speed has been significantly increased for all player characters.  
 Dashing in the Hall of Relics is now faster and snappier.  
 Rerolls are now much more player-friendly:
  - Costs reset upon leveling up (!)  
  - Adjusted formula for better scaling.  
 Arcane Mutators that previously cost gold to equip during a run are now free!  
  - Since you already paid for unlocking them in the Hall of Relics, this double charge felt unfair. I agreed, so it’s been changed.  
 Reworked the Quest Reward UI for better clarity, making it easier to see where you can redeem rewards (auto-redeem is coming in a future update).  
 Expanded upgrade outcome previews to include spell categories for better planning.  
 Improved text colors in Arcane Mutator upgrades for easier readability.  
 Settings are now saved using a new system to prevent conflicts with playtest/demo builds.  
 Added a feedback button to pause menus where it was previously missing.  
  

🔧 Tweaks  
  
 Dash mechanics tweaked for better balance.  
 Various small balance adjustments across abilities and gameplay.  
  

🐞 Bug Fixes  
 
 Improved boss AI movement, addressing a bug where Luminor could dart off over long distances.  
 Fixed unreliable item unlocks, ensuring more upgrade choices are now visible.  
 Resolved an issue where some upgrades appeared transparent.  
 Fixed controller UI navigation glitches.  
 Boss enemies are now cleared more aggressively when starting or leaving a game.  
 Quest board icons now update more reliably.  
 Area text now hides faster when paused in the Hall of Relics.  
 "During a run" achievements are now tracked more accurately.  
 Fixed missing metadata for the "Crimson Crown" item.  
 Improved item data handling for smoother gameplay under the hood.  
 Fixed display and logic issues with the mutator upgrade option view.  


🌐 Localization  
  
 Updated German translations for better accuracy and style.  
  

📜 Content & Other Updates  
  
 Added three new quests to enrich gameplay.  
 Updated credits to include new collaborators, including translators and awesome helpers.  
  

If you missed the last update, I shared details on how to provide your save file for bug reports, along with some topics that are on my radar:  

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2207230/view/546720876705350225  

More content and more fixes are, of course, in the works!
Stay tuned for upcoming updates. ✨

notes.title: Early Access Update 1 - Feedback & Fixes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We’re just over a day into Early Access for Black Dragon Mage, and I’m grateful for all the feedback you’ve shared so far. Thank you for taking the time to play and help shape the game’s future.

I know some players have encountered frustrating issues, and I’m working hard to address them. Early Access is about expanding and refining a game together. Your input helps guide these improvements as I add more content and tweak the foundation.

Here’s what I’m focusing on right now:


 🚀 Initial movement speed: Starting mobility on maps will be improved.
 🪄 Overall spell and staff scaling will be increased in pace.
 🐉 Dragon mode feeling more impactful: I’m adding the main weapon mastery effect to dragon mode to make attacks feel more impactful.
 🐲 Mana pickups in flight: You’ll soon be able to sustain your dragon’s flight by gathering mana while airborne.
 🔥 Pentagram spell vs. normal mobs: Pentagram will be adjusted so it’s not just useful against bosses, but more generally helpful.
 💣 Decanted Dragonbreath (the exploding flask) spell improvements: Upcoming spell upgrades will ensure the flask feels more on par with summoned flame and spiral strike.
 💎 Gold at the end of runs: Currently gold only exists in the material world (the Hall of Relics is a ghost realm) and I intend to keep it that way, but it feels bad to lose it at the end of a run. Sorry about that. How I intend to fix that, is to reward you with some Hall of Relics currencies for leftover gold.
 🔓 Some of the content currently locked behind progression will be unlocked by default, to allow for more interesting runs right out of the gate.


Addressing Bugs & Balance:
If you run into run-ending bugs, please help me investigate:

[olist]
 Close the game.
 Navigate to C:\Users\[YOURNAME]\AppData\LocalLow\datablob\
 Zip the contents of that folder (typically "Black Dragon Mage")
 Please add a brief message detailing what you intended to do and what the game did instead. (a short bug report)
 Send it to support@datablob.studio with [Bug Report] in the subject, or share it on Discord
[/olist]

What's next?

I have plans for the next batches of content updates, will keep you posted here - so make sure to follow the game's page if you're interested. More weapons, spell upgrades, among other elements that add more variety and depth. Further content is already in development!

I’m also looking at balancing difficulty, lowering upgrade costs, and making sure the game feels less grindy. The next layer of content will affect most of the game systems and hopefully add the depth we're all looking for.

If there’s a specific challenge you find too tough, let me know. If you have ideas on what would make the biggest impact for improving the game, feel free to send me your thoughts to support@datablob.studio with the subject [Ideas] as well!

Thank you again for your patience, understanding, and support.
Let’s continue shaping Black Dragon Mage together. 💌

~ Datablob, solo developer.

notes.title: Major Demo Update: Happy Halloween!
notes.notes:
Hey adventurers! How have you been? There have been a lot of updates and changes to the demo to give you a taste of the final game, many of which were inspired by community feedback!

You can use the pause menu to submit your thoughts, bug reports and general feedback directly to me while playing the game, by the way!

Stay tuned for more updates, thanks for joining me on this journey. <3
~ datablob


[hr][/hr]

🌟 New Features & Gameplay Enhancements 🌟

Changes to maps
🗺️ Maps are now procedural, infinitely large (instead of walled arenas), with more to uncover!
⚰️ Cemetery map has new lighting and ambient effects to deliver on a chilling atmosphere.
🧭 Added a mini map to show resources, enemies & more information.

More rogue-lite design, more build flexibility
💰  Gold now only exists within runs and is used to buy new upgrade types. You always start a run with 250 gold, collecting gold during your run unlocks further upgrade choices.
🍄 Mutator items are unlocked in the Hall of Relics, but instead of perma-equipping them, they then appear as upgrades during your run, making for a more varied experience.
🗡️ Main weapons and hats remain perma-unlocked and can be equipped prior to runs.

New Resource System & Upgrades that cost gold
💎 New resources are now your currency in the Hall of Relics!
⛏️ Mine for the first resource, Ice Crystals, by tracking them down on the map.
⚔️ Void Eyes now spawn in the desert, which can be used to unlock the cemetery door.
🎆 Elemental mana icons now appear on some of the upgrades. They're a new addition used to power up and multiply the effects of some upgrades, more to come.
❄️ New stackable passive spells that auto-trigger on cooldown.

First look at boss battles
👻 Added epic boss battles with rewards in their first iteration, more to come.
🔥 Summoned flame now has improved visuals, making it clearer and more satisfying.

Balancing and Core Loop
⌚ Runs are now shorter and end in a boss battle.
📊 New XP Curve to level up faster, speeding up the time until overpowered.
☄️ Mobs now spawn in more varied patterns, in greater numbers, with a rebalanced rhythm and reworked movement.
🃏 Upgrade choices are more shuffled, giving you more flexibility.
🎒 Redesigned loadout screen! You may notice that there are now multiple slots for characters and dragons...

🛠️ Quality of Life Improvements 🛠️
💨 All animations, cut scenes and various aspects of the game are now faster. Less waiting, more slaying!
🛒 Players can now buy items directly with their mouse for smoother shop interactions.
⌨️ Pick upgrades using just the keyboard (single-handed play)
🕹️ Resolved projectile overlay issues and improved shading for better player visibility behind projectiles.
☠️ Better player death sequence.
📈 See the outcome of stat calculations as a preview in the UI.
📊 Moved player & weapon stats to the pause screen to clean up UI and make it easily accessible.
🖥️ Various UI changes, such as moving the dragon-related UI elements all into the same corner.
🔊 Some of the sound effects are now 3D audio, so you can locate them better.
👁️ Added accessibility controls to reduce motion effects, for comfort.
🐉 You can pet the dragon in the Hall of Relics now.

🐛 Bug Fixes & Performance 🐛
🔧 Fixed several visual glitches across maps and menus. Improved widescreen and ultrawide support.
🎵 Fixed issues with music queueing.
🧹 Mobs with the dashing movement style were sometimes getting stuck while dying.
💬 Fixed bugs where localized text sometimes misaligned or replaced incorrectly in certain languages.
🔊 Reduced overlapping sound effects for a cleaner audio experience.
🧩 Loading sequence fixes to prevent crashes during map transitions.

notes.title: 🐉 development update & playtest beta v0.5.2
notes.notes:
Hey Adventurers, time for a new Black Dragon Mage development update!

Time flies when you're a solo indie and hard at work to make your game happen, it feels like it has only been a week or two since I've last posted an update, but it's flips through notes been 1.5 months plus already! I've returned from the depths of my arcane library with a long scroll of update notes for you.

A lot has happened and the game is under intense development, still on track to come out sometime later this year. The changes since the last update are way too many to list, so here's a quick pick of some of the highlights.

🌟 Curator resonance
More and more Steam Curators are posting their preview-reviews of Black Dragon Mage and I'm glad that they enjoy the demo so far:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44298033/5d3dc079933c11a663f5ee0067c32aa9690a0596.png

🛠️From the Forge of the Magi: Latest Dev News
The previous dev update can be found here, by the way.

The focus on boss fights is still strong, with the first boss being live and testable on the playtest of Black Dragon Mage now! In playtest[staging] v0.5.2, the following changes went live this weekend, for private testers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44298033/a146b407b121f48b740813c88569bd74b94454df.gif

✨ Playtest (staging branch) updated!

 preview of Boss Fight against LUMINOR, THE SHROUDED is finally playable!
 new area damage spell ❄️ ICE FORTRESS - casting ice spike mines in the shape of a snowflake, giving you more space to escape from sticky situations. Lower health mobs are killed by contact, higher health mobs can either freeze or get pushed away.
 all attribute upgrades get unique rolls and thus rarities/values now!
 reduced the round duration to snappy 15 minutes. At the end of a round, the massive stage boss appears. If you defeat a stage boss, you can continue your conquest for another round and keep growing your powers for as long as you want to (or survive!). The level progress bar indicates when you will encounter elites and bosses.
 experimental: spells now have a new underlying tree hierarchy, where certain spells become unlocked in a run if you own multiple prerequisite conditions (such as owning Spell A and Spell B and perhaps a certain main weapon), adding depth. This is mostly under the hood as of yet, waiting to be properly used with the next content update.
 preview your resulting stat changes when hovering over an upgrade! Players frequently requested more clarity and this is a nicer inline preview than having to look at the stats screen (which you can still do, btw).


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44298033/ade23bd5c124ac467666031c35fb4ee88980e8a5.gif

👁️ Testers might notice 

 countless bugs squashed (and probably some new ones to find)
 various UI changes, including integrating the mana bar with the dragon area at the bottom right for clarity
 accept upgrades with SPACE BAR (or mouse/A), so you can now play the game with one hand, particularly if you...
 toggle auto-fire with TAB key (or middle mouse)
 better game feel and super responsive inputs through reduced latency! You can now disable VSYNC in the settings and the frame limiter will take over, so that your GPU doesn't have to render extra frames. Borderless mode is now the default also. Cursor is not locked to game view.
 tons of stuff has changed under the hood, too much to list here, but game should feel even more responsive and smooth with even better battery life on Steam Deck
 player logs can be set to verbose for debugging & attached to bug reports in a privacy-friendly (sanitized) and opt-in way


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44298033/9d1ca1de4ef1ae06f5112a42cbede21756380c47.gif

Currently🚧 WIP
[olist]
 world difficulty does not increase after beating a round, that will change soon (enemies and bosses will scale with each round you beat)
 there's no "ok, I'd like to exit this run now that I've beat x rounds" mechanic yet, but I have something planned to make every run feel more like an expedition with increasing stakes
 boss sequencing (of its many different behaviours) is still being iterated on, expect changes very soon, it's more of a quick demo of how the boss moves and operates, but all of the bits and pieces are there now
 new ❄️ area spell will likely move to becoming passive mastery that doesn't take up an ability slot
 ❄️ area spell only has a dummy cooldown of 1s for demoing
[/olist]

🔭 What's next?

Once the current testing build passes a bit of private playtesting on my Discord, I will update the public demo with the new content and changes.

Initially I had planned to not maintain the demo in parallel (since that takes additional effort and I'm only one guy), but I understand that it's ultimately better for the game to receive on-going player feedback and added exposure through frequent updates. That means: The demo will as of then be kept updated until release, so that you get a little taste of where the game is moving.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44298033/4cab05ff90a3cc6500eec0c989c9f5fcf731207b.png

Stay tuned for more updates, coming soon!
And thanks for all the kind words and support, you keep me going on this journey! 🧙‍♂️💖

notes.title: Tips & Tricks for the Demo! Also: Patch Preview Notes
notes.notes:
Don't miss the second map!

The second door in the hall of relics (next to the desert door) will open at some point during the demo. Keep playing if it has not opened for you yet! I've seen some streamers that haven't entered the second map, but it's there. :)

You can continue playing the demo even after winning a round by hitting the resume button.

Don't miss the dragon!
When your power bar (the blue one) is full, you can summon the dragon with the right mouse button (or the right shoulder button, RB, on a controller). I've seen people miss that bit and will improve the onboarding/UX for that feature.

Wealth is coming
I'm aware that the gold gain rate is too low, will ship a patch to help with that. I want you to be able to afford at least one or two weapons more quickly! Especially my favourite, the Prismatic Staff with chain lightning!

Patches are coming
There will be various bug fixes shortly, please keep reporting them via the in-game system (pause during a run, there you'll find the bug report option).

My next priorities besides fixing bugs are to add depth to the abilities, so that they scale in more interesting (and formidable) ways, opening up more builds. I'm aware that some players prefer auto-aim, so DPS passives are also on the roadmap to enable more flexible builds that rely more/less on aiming. Aiming will be important for bosses, so I don't want to eliminate it entirely. I'm also looking into improving control layouts (dashing is not ideally positioned) and perhaps introducing an auto-attack toggle that keeps your main attack active.
